questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-101
questions.question: On a road which has no sidewalks a pedestrian should walk on the:

options.text: Side of the road which has the lightest traffic
Same side of the road in which traffic is moving
Side of the road facing oncoming traffic
Side of the road which has the heaviest traffic

questions.answer_text: Side of the road facing oncoming traffic

questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-99
questions.question: What does a "slow moving vehicle" emblem look like?

options.text: A square red sign
A round green sign
A diamon-shaped yellow sign
A triangular orange sign

questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-96
questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway. You see children playing nearby. Before you start to move your car you should:

options.text: Race your motor to warn the children that you are moving
Sound your horn so the children will hear you
Walk to the back of the car to be sure the way is clear
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway

questions.answer_text: Walk to the back of the car to be sure the way is clear

questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-98
questions.question: Motorists should be aware that all bicycles used after dark must have:

options.text: Reflective handlebar grips
A front headlight and red taillight
White reflectors on the front and rear fenders
Brake lights

questions.answer_text: A front headlight and red taillight

questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-100
questions.question: A motorist should know that a bicyclist operating on a roadway must:

options.text: Ride on the right side of the road
Ride on the side of the road facing traffic
Ride on either side of the road
Ride on the side of the road with the least traffic

questions.answer_text: Ride on the right side of the road

questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-97
questions.question: A motorist approaching a bicyclist should:

options.text: Speed up to pass him
Proceed as usual
Swerve into the opposite lane
Exercise extreme caution

questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-103
questions.question: A blind person legally has the right-of-way when crossing the street when:

options.text: Wearing light-colored clothing
Led by a guide dog, or using a white or metallic cane
Helped by another person
Wearing dark-colored glasses

questions.answer_text: Led by a guide dog, or using a white or metallic cane

questions.name: sgE-7355143-1-102
questions.question: A bicyclist differs from a motorist in that a bicyclist isn't required to:

options.text: Obey the same traffic laws
Signal all turns
Report accidents resulting in serious injury
Insure the bicycle
